convert_optical_flow_to_rgb: convert a 4D optical flow tensor to a 3-channel RGB color map for visualization
visualize_flow_field: visualize an optical flow field by encoding direction as hue and magnitude as value in HSV
compute_flow_angles: compute flow direction angles in the 0 to 360 degree range using atan2 on flow components
normalize_flow_magnitude: normalize optical flow magnitude to 0-1 range by subtracting min and dividing by max plus epsilon
review_optical_flow_to_color: review the optical_flow_to_color function that converts flow tensors to RGB images via HSV colorspace
